{{Short description|City in Ukhdari}}

'''Mukar''' is a city in [[Ukhdari]] in central [[Ayuma]]. It was one of nine cities selected as a host city for the [[1760 FLLA World Cup]].

The Mukar City Stadium, a 47,800-seat venue, hosted seven matches at the 1760 tournament, including the round-of-sixteen tie between [[Pelines]] and [[Sivoso]], which finished 4-5 to Sivoso and was the highest-scoring fixture of the knockout stage. The stadium was extensively redeveloped during the bidding period in advance of the tournament.
